title: 第24章 气血丹第25章 突破淬皮境中阶
lines: 第24章气血丹
“堂姐说的是，我会自己收拾他的。”
叶亮面色尬住了，从小被楚生压一头。
加上上次被楚生一招击败，让他失去了自信，剩下的只有盲目的怨恨，都忘记自己已经成为武者了。
经过叶桃夭的提醒，叶亮才想起来，脸上那种得意的表情再次浮现起来。
楚生一个屠夫，空有一身蛮力，怎么可能是自己的对手？
如今他已经通臂拳入门，气血也比之前增强了十几倍。
一个屠夫，自己竟然害怕了？
丢人，真他娘丢人！
而且还是在叶家主家嫡女面前出丑！
叶亮对楚生的怨恨更生了！
叶亮父亲原本是内城叶家现任家主的弟弟，只是因为没有修炼根骨，便被派到外城经营城北叶家的边缘产业。
因此，叶亮从出生到长大都是在城北叶家，直到一个月前进入武馆，测出有修炼根骨，他才和内城主家搭上了联系。
今日便是因为他刚成为武者，家主大伯便让这个堂姐叶桃夭来带自己购置气血丹，稳固境界，不曾想到遇到了楚生，而且还让自己丢了脸。
可想而知，自己在堂姐面前，地位肯定又下降了几分。
见到叶亮低头，一脸通红的模样，叶桃夭面色更加不屑，摇摇头心中暗道：“终究是外城叶家，上不了台面。”
“是啊，楚生，你家什么条件，我还不清楚吗？你一家穷鬼，怎么可能买得起丹药？还是老老实实做你的屠夫吧，一身蛮力也只配与牲畜为伍罢了！”
柳玉看到楚生在武道阁，心情很不爽，自己和叶亮一起来，也只能来这里开开眼界，都没有买这里的任何东西，这是楚生能来的地方吗？
丹药区负责人见到叶亮几人走来，连忙迎了上去，笑道：“叶小姐，不知您有什么需要？”
叶桃夭淡淡道：“给我五十枚聚血丹，五瓶气血丹。”
“是，叶小姐，您请坐，稍等一下，我这就给您拿来！”丹药区负责人和悦道。
聚血丹虽然也是一品丹药，但是效果是气血丹的三倍不止，价格更是一百两一枚，五十枚聚血丹价值五千两了，也只有五大势力中核心人员才能有这个财力。
光这一单，就比得上她两三个月的销售额了，让她如何不开心。
方才的不爽，此刻烟消云散，走过苏酥身边都多了一丝得意之态。
而此时的苏酥，脸上也失去了笑容，不是生气，而是严肃地对楚生说道：“楚公子，气血丹和淬皮液都要是武者才能使用，盲目使用恐怕会有性命之忧。”
上次只是送楚生去了二楼鉴定区入口，并没有看到楚生考核成功，现在也没有见到楚生带上武道徽章，这让她不得不担心起来。
“内城叶家？这个女子，就是上次叶亮说的叶桃夭？”楚生看着对方，心中暗自揣测着，不知道自己是不是对方的对手。
看到叶桃夭也是买丹药，并没有针对自己的样子，楚生才安心不少。
而叶亮和柳玉，在楚生眼里就像路边一条，他懒得瞧一眼，对着真诚的苏酥说道：“苏酥姑娘，无妨，你给我取二十瓶气血丹，五瓶淬皮液。”
楚生一边说，一边将武道徽章扣在胸口上。
他算是发现了，怪不得路上很多武者，都会戴上武道徽章这个武者标志了。

Chapter 24 Qi and Blood Pill
"What my cousin said is that I will take care of him myself."
Ye Liang looked embarrassed, having been suppressed by Chu Sheng since he was a child.
In addition, he was defeated by Chu Sheng with one move last time, which made him lose his confidence. All that was left was blind resentment, and he forgot that he had become a warrior.
After Ye Taoyao's reminder, Ye Liang remembered it, and the proud expression appeared on his face again.
Chu Sheng was a butcher with no brute strength. How could he be his opponent?
Now that he has mastered the Tongjiquan, his energy and blood have increased ten times more than before.
A butcher, he is actually afraid?
Shameful, so fucking disgraceful!
And she still made a fool of herself in front of the daughter of the head of the Ye family!
Ye Liang's resentment towards Chu Sheng was renewed!
Ye Liang's father was originally the younger brother of the current head of the Ye family in the inner city. However, because he had no cultivation skills, he was sent to the outer city to run the marginal industries of the Ye family in the north of the city.
Therefore, Ye Liang lived in the Ye family in the north of the city from birth to growing up. It was not until he entered the martial arts gym a month ago and found out that he had a cultivation base that he got in touch with the master's family in the inner city.
Today, because he had just become a warrior, the uncle of the family asked his cousin Ye Taoyao to take him to buy Qi and Blood Pills to stabilize his realm. He never expected that he would meet Chu Sheng and even embarrass himself.
It is conceivable that his status in front of his cousin must have dropped a bit.
Seeing Ye Liang lowering his head with a red face, Ye Taoyao's expression became even more disdainful. He shook his head and thought to himself: "After all, it's the Ye family from the outer city who can't get on the stage."
"Yes, Chu Sheng, I don't know what your family's conditions are like? How can you, a poor family, afford elixirs? I'd better be your butcher. Your brute strength is only worthy of working with livestock!"
Liu Yu felt very unhappy when she saw Chu Sheng in the Martial Arts Pavilion. She and Ye Liang came together and could only come here to broaden their horizons. They didn't buy anything here. Is this a place where Chu Sheng could come?
When the person in charge of the elixir area saw Ye Liang and others approaching, he hurriedly greeted them and said with a smile: "Miss Ye, what do you need?"
Ye Taoyao said calmly: "Give me fifty blood gathering pills and five bottles of Qi and blood pills."
"Yes, Miss Ye, please sit down and wait a moment, I will get it for you right now!" the person in charge of the elixir area said pleasantly.
Although the Blood Gathering Pill is also a first-grade elixir, its effect is more than three times that of the Qi and Blood Pill, and the price is one hundred taels each. Fifty Blood Gathering Pills are worth five thousand taels. Only the core personnel of the five major forces can have this financial resources.
This single order alone was comparable to her sales in two or three months, which made her unhappy.
The unhappiness he felt just now disappeared, and everyone who walked by Su Su felt a little more proud.
At this time, Su Su also lost the smile on her face. She was not angry, but said to Chu Sheng seriously: "Mr. Chu, only warriors can use Qi Blood Pill and Skin Tempering Liquid. If you use them blindly, your life may be in danger."
Last time, she just sent Chu Sheng to the entrance of the appraisal area on the second floor. She didn't see Chu Sheng succeed in the assessment. Now she didn't see Chu Sheng wearing the martial arts badge, which made her have to worry.
"The Ye family in the inner city? Is this woman the Ye Taoyao that Ye Liang mentioned last time?" Chu Sheng looked at the other party, secretly guessing whether he was his opponent or not.
Chu Sheng felt relieved when he saw that Ye Taoyao was also buying elixirs and was not targeting him.
Ye Liang and Liu Yu were just like two people on the roadside in Chu Sheng's eyes. He didn't bother to take a look and said to the sincere Su Su, "Miss Su Su, it's okay. You can get me twenty bottles of Qi Blood Pills and five bottles of Skin Quenching Liquid."
Chu Sheng said as he put the martial arts badge on his chest.
He finally discovered it. No wonder many warriors on the road wore martial arts badges, the symbol of a warrior.
title_en: Chapter 24 Qi and Blood Pill Chapter 25 Breakthrough to the Intermediate Level of Skin Tempering Realm
